definitions.explanation: An honorific term used to refer to the recipient's company in written correspondence such as business letters, emails, and job application documents.

examples.japanese: {貴社|きしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I wish your company continued growth.

examples.japanese: {貴社|きしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I am applying for the position at your company.

examples.japanese: {貴社|きしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧お⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{伺|うかが}いたく⟦{存|ぞん}じます→存じる：05912_zonjiru⟧。
examples.english: I would like to hear more details about your company's products.

notes:
USAGE:
{貴社|きしゃ} is used exclusively in written communication. In spoken language, ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧ is used instead. This distinction is important and commonly tested in job interview preparation.
Because きしゃ is a homophone of ⟦{汽車|きしゃ}→汽車：01381_kisha⟧ (train) and ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧ (reporter), it is almost always used in writing where the kanji makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貴社|きしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧ (your company's growth)
- {貴社|きしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to apply to your company)
- {貴社|きしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{繁栄|はんえい}→繁栄：10131_hanei⟧ (your company's prosperity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧: your company (honorific, spoken)
- ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧: our company (humble form)
- ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧: our company (neutral)
